cross_item_pattern.rule: In every 'Do the results support this claim? Yes/No; <evidence>' item, all four evidence statements are true in the table, so the key is decidable without the passage: it is the only option whose evidence logically bears on the claim as worded (a counterexample for a general/universal claim; a high-end small increment for 'levels off'). Distractors cite evidence that is irrelevant to the claim, contradicts their own Yes/No, or is a single confirming case offered for a universal claim.
